items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Then the band that everybody listened to was Jean Goldkette.

ctx.x: What kinds of things was Lester listening to? Well, what else were you listening to, first of all?
Well, that was the general kind of music that everybody listened to. Then the band that everybody listened to was Jean Goldkette.
Did you own a record player at that time?
